Live data without plumbing

Live queries track row dependencies and push minimal patches (SSE with Last-Event-ID replay, WebSocket where open, polling fallback). Background @task jobs persist on Redis with retries and progress; @cache(minutes=5) + SWR covers reads.

msgs = live(Message.where(room=current_room))

@task
def generate_report(user: User): ...
job = generate_report(user)
if job.pending: <Spinner />

@cache(minutes=5)
def product_list(): ...
PrimitiveSemantics
live(query)Server re-runs on notify; client applies minimal patch; reconnect replays from Last-Event-ID
@taskQueued, persisted, retried with backoff; progress + cancellation + tracing flow into the request trace
@cacheMemory + Redis + CDN layers; tags + SWR; never silently caches correctness-sensitive ops
sync modelsOffline queue replays on reconnect; last-writer-wins + tombstones + conflict reports; optimistic UI rolls back on failure
